data: same flat train.bin/val.bin as Phase 0 (1.50B train tokens); seq_len is a view parameter, no repack
optimizer_recipe: same as train.py: fused AdamW b(0.9,0.95), cosine LR to 0.1x, wd 0.1, clip 1.0, warmup then decay
budget_per_stage_tokens: 32768 tok/step global batch at every stage; --max-iters sets stage budget (10000 iters = 328M tokens)

stages.name: rope-1024-parity
stages.purpose: RoPE-vs-wpe parity at matched budget; gate for the extension line (expect final val within ~0.03 of wpe baseline 124m-baseline)

stages.name: lc-32k
stages.purpose: context extension stage 2 (32x total); YaRN factor 32, chunked CE + block checkpointing engage

ablation_cells.name: wpe-32k-ext
ablation_cells.purpose: position-encoding axis control: extend the wpe baseline table (tail-tiled) to 32k under identical budget; quantifies wpe-vs-RoPE extension gap

ablation_cells.name: lc-32k-scratch (optional)
ablation_cells.purpose: separate native-long cell: RoPE 32k from scratch, no curriculum -- isolates what continued training contributes

eval_protocol.long_range_ppl: eval_lengths.csv: fixed-seed val loss at 1024/2048/8192/32768 every 1000 iters (loss-vs-context curve per stage)
eval_protocol.niah: separate harness (planned); 32k single-needle over FineWeb-Edu distractors + multi-needle variant
eval_protocol.note: MHA-vs-GQA-vs-MLA KV differences are NOT expected to separate at 32k on 16GB; those need 128k+ or enforced equal KV budget with eviction
